stitchingVias.name: GND_AUDIO_BRIDGE
stitchingVias.rationale: Diagnosed F.Cu GND fragment bbox x12.6397..17.4765,y0.1505..2.4411. KiCad filled polygon readback proves full 0.6mm via circle at (13.4,0.8) lies in both F.Cu and B.Cu GND fill and >0.35mm outside every pad bbox. Joins analog return to bottom ground without via-in-pad.

componentOrientations.rationale: Vertical receptacle on service/back face; mating axis normal to board toward rear case.
